title: App Shell
description: SAP Fiori launchpad-style shell: a ShellBar wired to notifications, user menu and product switch popovers, with a side navigation slot and a content area.

usage.summary: Frame application pages with shared shell actions, optional side navigation and a scrolling content area.
useWhen: Work across application pages while retaining global search, notifications, profile and product access.
Start from shell actions already wired to their notification, product-switch and user-menu surfaces.
Supply page content as children and an optional sideNavigation slot; replace the sample account, search and notification data.

avoidWhen.when: Compose your own header, vertical navigation and content without the sample shell integrations.
Build an entry point with selected business-area navigation and app-tile content.
Build the business page itself: filter records, inspect one object, or browse an adjacent list and detail.
Show an empty or recovery view within a frame that already exists.

layout: header: ShellBar with ShellBarBranding, ShellBarSearch, SearchItem, Avatar and ShellBarItem
menu trigger: Button with Icon when side navigation is a render function
notification surface: Popover with PopoverAnchor and PopoverContent
product surface: Popover with PopoverAnchor and PopoverContent
body: PopoverBody with ProductSwitch and ProductSwitchItem
body: optional caller-supplied side navigation beside scrolling main content
default content: Card with Title and Text; replaced by children
variations: Replace the placeholder content with the application’s page and supply sideNavigation as a render function to connect its collapsed state to the menu button.
Replace sample search results, account, product targets and notification handlers with application services; preserve each shell action’s opener and focus return.
Omit sideNavigation for a page that needs no navigation rail; the menu trigger is then absent.
